info.description:
This course provides knowledge of all basic sociological research methods as well as understanding of specific communication research and assessment instruments. As a result, the students will gain a practical understanding of research, evaluation in academic and professional settings. The course program includes practical acquaintance with contemporary media and social networks monitoring systems.

Note:
I. Prohibit all forms of copyright infringement, and plagiarism in all ideas, documents and media productions and fraud during the course including all ongoing tests and final examinations. A plagiarism percentage of more than 20 per cent (checked by Turnitin) indicates that a student plagiarised with the intent to cheat.
II. Recomments:
AI tools can be useful educational tools when employed properly
A. AI tools are generally acceptable for:
1. Generating ideas through brainstorming
2. Proofreading and conducting grammar checks
3. Clarifying complex ideas
4. Creating practice questions
5. Arranging research notes
6. Data visualization (in reference to AI tools)
7. Image or video creations (in reference to AI tools)
Content generated by AI tools must be referenced. Any work generated by AI without the appropriate reference will be considered a cheat attempt and assessed on a case-by-case basis.
B. AI tools are not recommended for:
1. Complete assignments or exams that are intended to evaluate your knowledge.
2. Creating essays or reports on your behalf
3. Bypassing the development of research skills

assessments.note: Participation grade will be given based on students' attendance, preparation, and quantity as well as quality of participation in classroom; quality of participation is demonstrated through asking relevant questions, making statements that add to and facilitate class discussion, and builds upon others’ comments.

assessments.questionType: This is a group-based project. Each group of 4-6 members work together to select a research topic in communication area and submit a research proposal to lecturer and other classmates.;
assessments.knowledgeSkill: Based on topics of studied units;
assessments.note:
This assignment has 2 components: Research Proposal + PPT slide for oral presentation.

- At the end of the proposal, students are required to write a short exlanation about how they apply AI. This criterion follows the instructions below.
+ Students are permitted to use in-built generative AI such as research paper summary, literature review editing, seaching secondary data but are required to generate their own responses in line with conditions and expectations of the task.
+ At the end of this assigment, students are required to write a short paragragh (150-200 words) about how they use AI.
+ Students provide screenshot as evidence of using AI.

All assignments should be typed and double-spaced with 12-point font, and must be submitted in soft copy. A deduction of 10% of the assignment mark will be applied for each day of late submission.
